title: [NotMyRip] Euphoria (BD+DVD)
description:
I got irritated that the only source of bluray raws for Euphoria on here was a hardsubbed Portuguese copy, so I made my own. With blackjack, and hookers. Well not really, but I did find a BDISO for episodes 1~2 and a really nice rip of 3~4. So I did my own encode of 1~2 (with chapters), included the already-chaptered rip of 3~4, and the DVD rips of 5~6 since apparently they never released a third bluray volume. The DVDrips of 5 and 6 are MP4 remuxes of the episodes found in #2331552 but without the music-less audio track. Subs are not included because I'm not going to waste time trying to figure out how to merge the individual-episode sub files into dual-episode ones. If I were I'd fix the shitty translations while I was at it, but eh. Effort.

So remember--it's NotMyRip!
